stack_scope: Context apply and inverse restore exact known previous tree through #940; this stack was not natively built for this receipt.
scope: Actual native local_config_summary against inert fixture runtime. Test-only current-thread wrapper counts exact diagnostic helper invocations (not syscalls, launch, watcher, storage or unrelated route work). Full response bytes compared with per-case disposable temp root, cwd and session path replaced. Diagnostic entry fixtures are not used to parse/reload config content. Steady names for exact parity; changing files may intentionally produce one consistent observation now instead of two discrepant ones.

reproduction.runner:
set -eu
here=$PWD
: "${PROTEUS_TEST_REFERENCE_MODULE:?point to the matching inert fixture executable}"
: "${PROTEUS_TEST_SESSION_STORAGE_MODULE:?point to the matching inert fixture executable}"
for arm in stock owner; do (
 cd "$arm"
 c=crates/proteus-core/src
 path=$c/app_server/session_model/tests.rs
 summary=$c/app_server/config_summary.rs
 for f in "$path" "$summary"; do cp "$f" "$f.w336-backup"; done
 sed -i 's/= config_files(/= measured_config_files(/g; s/config_files: config_files(/config_files: measured_config_files(/g' "$summary"
 cat "$here/counter.rs" >>"$summary"
 cat "$here/probe.rs" >>"$path"
 cargo test --offline --locked --release -p proteus-core --lib --no-run -j 4 >"$here/$arm.build.log" 2>&1
 grep -F "($here/$arm/crates/proteus-core)" "$here/$arm.build.log"
 bin=$(sed -nE 's/.*Executable unittests src\/lib.rs \(([^)]+)\).*/\1/p' "$here/$arm.build.log")
 cp "$bin" "$here/$arm-tests"
 for f in "$path" "$summary"; do mv "$f.w336-backup" "$f"; done
 cd crates/proteus-core
 mkdir -p "$here/$arm.wire"
 W336_WITNESS_DIR="$here/$arm.wire" "$here/$arm-tests" 'app_server::session_model::' --test-threads=1 --nocapture >"$here/$arm.test.log" 2>&1
 "$here/$arm-tests" 'app_server::http::tests::' --test-threads=1 --nocapture >"$here/$arm.api.log" 2>&1
); done
reproduction.runner_environment: Supply the matching local inert reference and session-storage fixtures from the existing Core test setup to the runner. Both native binaries are standalone stock/candidate, not full-app releases.
